Read: abstract, introduction, methods 2.1 and 2.4 (others skimmed by heading), results 3.1 and 3.2 in full, discussion; Results 3.3 to 3.5 (adhesion, colony, invasion) were not read in detail and Figures 3 to 6 were not opened, so results are partial and figures captions_only beyond Figures 1 and 2; depth partial.

entries.proposition: Stable over-expression is large and cell-line dependent: mean relative WWOX protein rises 2.6-fold (T98G) to 14.7-fold (DBTRG-05MG), 12-fold (U251MG) and 10-fold (U87MG) over control, from one blot per line with three lanes each (Figure 1E).
entries.snippet: The mean relative protein level of “WWOX” was significantly higher (20.93 ± 0.8359 for T98G; 11.72 ± 0.8161 for DBTRG-05MG; 0.86 ± 0.3365 for U251MG; and 12.50 ± 1.6540 for U87MG)

experimental_context.system: four human glioblastoma cell lines (T98G, DBTRG-05MG, U251MG, U87MG), lentiviral stable WWOX over-expression against empty-vector control
experimental_context.endpoint: TUNEL, BrdU, PrestoBlue fluorescence, adhesion, colony and invasion assays

entries.proposition: Over-expression increased TUNEL apoptosis in T98G, DBTRG-05MG and U87MG; Figure 2A bars give about 11.7k against 8.7k, 8.0k against 5.6k and 7.8k against 4.3k RFU, and no change in U251MG (about 6.9k against 6.5k).
entries.snippet: Overexpression of WWOX significantly intensified the programmed cell death of T98G (p = 0.042), DBTRG-05MG (p = 0.009), and U87MG (p = 0.021) cells (Figure 2A).

entries.proposition: The text cites Figure 1B for the proliferation result; the proliferation bars are Figure 2B (BrdU: T98G about 31k against 93k, U87MG about 27k against 47k, DBTRG-05MG up about 87k against 31k, U251MG ns).
entries.snippet: In terms of proliferation, the “WWOX” variant significantly reduced this biological process in T98G (p = 0.0041) and U87MG (p = 0.0264) cells, whereas it increased in DBTRG-05MG (p < 0.0001) (Figure 1B).

entries.proposition: The section title and text call the PrestoBlue readout mitochondrial redox potential and cell viability; PrestoBlue is a resazurin-reduction fluorescence assay of overall cellular reducing capacity, read here as fluorescence at eight times over 80 minutes, not a mitochondrial-specific measurement.
entries.snippet: 10 µL of PrestoBlue reagent (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Naarden, The Netherlands) was added to the wells, and fluorescence (excitation at 550 nm and emission at 590 nm) was measured eight times at 10 min intervals

entries.proposition: In every line over-expression lowered the PrestoBlue signal (Figure 2C at 80 min: T98G about 130k against 240k, DBTRG-05MG about 225k against 390k, U251MG about 190k against 285k, U87MG about 120k against 265k RFU); DBTRG-05MG falls although its BrdU proliferation rises about 2.8-fold and its apoptosis rises, so the reducing-capacity readout and proliferation dissociate in that line.

entries.proposition: The authors state their limits: in-vitro findings often fail to extrapolate to the organism, the DBTRG-05MG discrepancy is unexplained, and in-vivo validation is needed.
entries.snippet: the in vitro findings often fail to extrapolate the cellular conditions in an organism, so future in vivo validation is recommended.
